subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the focused fresh-session bugfix now, or wait for the broader reattach-first recovery direction tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch is correct and proof-backed for the narrow session collision, but accepted-disconnect fallback can still run twice and may double `--deliver`, so maintainers need to own that behavior tradeoff.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Merge this narrow same-session collision fix after ordinary review, and keep reattach-first recovery as the separate product decision in the related issue.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first
options.body: Ask the author to extend this branch so accepted disconnects wait or reattach before falling back locally, reducing duplicate execution at the cost of a larger behavior change.

options.title: Pause until direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether recook-first fallback remains acceptable for accepted gateway disconnects.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow same-session collision fix after ordinary review, and keep reattach-first recovery as the separate product decision in the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/session-state history makes this the strongest available owner for the fallback behavior tradeoff.
